title: This Week in Finance & Tech
body:
Nvidia added nearly $1 trillion in market value this week following the reinstatement of CEO Jensen Huang. His return comes after significant pressure from President Trump, who cited the U.S. attorney general in defending the move. While the company faces ongoing export-control investigations, the market responded positively to the leadership change, helping lift the Nasdaq by 6.5 percent.

Elsewhere in the AI sector, Anthropic made history as the first pure-play AI developer to go public. The company saw a record-setting IPO, with shares opening 34 percent higher and briefly valuing the firm at over $2 trillion. Despite the strong debut, broader Wall Street indexes closed lower, and the event was met with protests outside the Nasdaq that resulted in three arrests.

In infrastructure news, the U.S. government approved SpaceX’s plan to launch a constellation of one million data satellites. Known as Starmind, the project aims to address the rising global demand for AI computing power by creating a more energy-efficient network in space.
